name: Nakatsu Namie
source:
Namie attended the same school and class as the protagonist, who happens to study at the same university as him as well. She is currently in a relationship with [url=/c98563]Ayaka[/url], but she gets jealous after the latter performs the  "XYX" drug experiment on the protagonist. Namie ends up taking the drug out of spite and turns into a man.

[Translated from [url=https://gyutto.com/i/item875?select_uaflag=1]Gyutto[/url].]
